title: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android: call quality feedback surveys after meetings
summary: Hold: the control's Learn link documents the generic Cloud Policy wizard, but not the survey setting readers are being told to configure. The licensing requirement also omits Microsoft's explicit allowance for valid legacy Teams Rooms licences.

claims.claim: Microsoft's feedback policy page says Microsoft acts as a data processor for tenant feedback.
claims.quote: Microsoft acts as a data processor for your tenant's feedback.

claims.claim: The feedback policy page says feedback collected from users is available in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: The feedback we collect from your users is available in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.claim: The feedback policy page lists Teams Rooms as connected to in-product survey policies.
claims.quote: | Teams Rooms | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |

claims.claim: The feedback policy page does not specifically identify Android for its Teams Rooms entry.
claims.quote: Searched: Android and Teams Rooms in the full fetched feedback-manage page. The Teams Rooms row has no platform qualifier; the separate Intune Company Portal row is labelled Android.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a new identity, permission or sign-in requirement for these surveys.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys identity permissions; Teams Rooms surveys permissions; managing surveys signed-in room accounts. Read release notes, feedback-manage and rooms-manage search excerpts; no new survey-specific requirement found.

claims.claim: The managing Teams Rooms documentation says surveys can appear to signed-in room accounts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Teams Rooms devices require Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic or Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices should only be assigned Teams Rooms Basic or Teams Rooms Pro licenses (Teams Rooms legacy licenses are also valid).
claims.fix: Replace the requirement in licensing.notes and Cost and licensing with: 'Teams Rooms devices require a Teams Rooms licence: Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic or Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro; valid Teams Rooms legacy licences are also accepted.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/rooms/rooms-plan.

claims.claim: The licensing model is included in the Teams Rooms product licence already required.
claims.quote: Each meeting room needs a Teams Rooms license, such as a Teams Rooms console, Surface Hub, or Teams panel. Teams provides two licenses for Teams Rooms: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro and Microsoft Teams Rooms Basic.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms call quality surveys license; Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys licensing price. Read rooms-plan, rooms-release-note and rooms-licensing search excerpts. No additional survey-specific licence requirement found.

claims.claim: No survey-specific meter has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys data storage retention licensing price identity permissions. Read rooms-plan, rooms-release-note, feedback-manage and rooms-licensing search excerpts; none names a survey meter.

claims.claim: No survey-specific price has been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams Rooms Android call quality feedback surveys licensing price; Teams Rooms call quality surveys license. Read rooms-plan, rooms-release-note and rooms-licensing search excerpts; no survey-specific price found.

claims.claim: The Android release notes introduce Call Quality Feedback surveys in app version 1449/1.0.96.2026344105, November 2026.
claims.quote: 1449/1.0.96.2026344105 (November 2026) [...] Call Quality Feedback surveys: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences

claims.claim: Microsoft says feature availability can vary by device make and model.
claims.quote: There can be a delay between when features are released by Microsoft and when they become available on a device make and model.

claims.claim: Managing devices through the Teams admin center requires the Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator role.
claims.quote: To manage devices using the Teams admin center, you need to be assigned Teams Administrator or Teams Devices Administrator roles.

claims.claim: The linked Cloud Policy overview documents the route through Configure Settings to Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft.
claims.quote: Searched: full Cloud Policy overview for the survey setting. It gives Customization > Policy Management > Policy configurations > Create > Start with the basics > Choose the scope > Configure Settings, but not the named control; feedback-manage supplies that last step.
claims.fix: Keep the path unchanged, but set controls[0].ui.docs and the rendered row's Learn link to https://learn.microsoft.com/privacy/microsoft-365/feedback/feedback-manage, which names the survey control and links to the Cloud Policy wizard. Retain the Cloud Policy overview in sources for the preceding route.

claims.claim: The Cloud Policy control has user scope.
claims.quote: Policies only apply to user objects.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Governance controls; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Cloud Policy feedback settings can disable Teams Rooms in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts.
claims.quote: Teams Rooms devices may display in-product surveys, including call quality feedback prompts, to signed-in room accounts. To disable these surveys, use the Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: The Android release notes explicitly say Call Quality Feedback surveys can be controlled using feedback policies.
claims.quote: These results are visible in the Call Quality Dashboard and can be controlled using feedback policies.

claims.claim: For the listed feedback policies, Not Configured has the same effect as Enabled.
claims.quote: When the following policies are set to Not Configured, it has the same effect as if you set the policies to Enabled.

claims.claim: Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft controls whether surveys appear, and disabling it suppresses them.
claims.quote: | Allow users to receive and respond to in-product surveys from Microsoft | Controls whether surveys appear within product. |

claims.claim: Office Apps Administrator is the recommended role for managing Cloud Policy.
claims.quote: Office Apps Administrator (Recommended)

claims.claim: Feedback policy changes can take a few hours to reach clients.
claims.quote: After you apply policies, it can take a few hours for the client applications to update.
